world_sweep.hormuz: Strait of Hormuz closed. US naval blockade in effect, 8 vessel attacks reported this month, Trump confirms no negotiations with Tehran. Five-month US-Israel-Iran war in fragile pause. Oil spiked to $105/bbl on 2026-07-23, now ~$86.
world_sweep.oil_supply_demand: Counterweight: OPEC+ raising production into a 2026 glut; IEA and OPEC both cut 2026 demand by ~1.6 mb/d because of the closure. JPM sees Brent $86 Q3 -> $80 Q4 -> $78 year end. Goldman also lower.
world_sweep.uranium: Long-term contract uranium $90/lb, highest since 2008. 2025 supply 173M lb vs demand 204M lb. AI datacenters: DOE projects 12% of US electricity by 2028; Constellation guides hyperscaler spend +75% YoY. Strongest structural signal found — but untradeable, see blocked_ideas.
world_sweep.semis: Nvidia China AI-chip share forecast to fall 40% -> 8%; Huawei Ascend 950 rated comparable to H200; export policy incoherent with a 25% tariff. Structurally negative for NVDAX.
world_sweep.crypto: 08-19 rally on SEC proposed framework (mature assets exiting securities classification) plus Treasury doubling bond buybacks — amplified by ~$1.44B of short liquidations.
world_sweep.fed: Held 3.50-3.75% but 9-3 with three dissenters wanting a hike; September hike odds ~72%. FOMC minutes 2026-08-20 18:00 UTC.

orders.reasoning: Most direct tradeable expression of the largest live geopolitical event. Hormuz is under active naval blockade with no negotiations, yet USOX is calm at +2.11% and oil sits ~$86 — well below the $105 it printed on 23 July. The market is pricing reopening and the OPEC+ glut. That makes the payoff asymmetric: escalation or simple persistence retests ~$105 (+22%), resolution takes oil to ~$78 (-9%). Book is liquid (0.03% spread, deep top of book) so entry cost is negligible.
orders.counter_case: The closure is simultaneously bearish demand — the same blockade is why IEA/OPEC cut forecasts 1.6 mb/d. Both Goldman and JPM forecast oil lower into year end, and OPEC+ keeps adding barrels. If Hormuz reopens this is a fast -10%. USOX also tracks WTI futures, so contango decay bleeds a long position held for months.
orders.falsifier: A credible US-Iran negotiation restart, or confirmed reopening of Hormuz transit. Also exit if WTI closes below ~$80, which would confirm glut over geopolitics.

passed_on.why: BTC +11.1% and ETH +19.0% in two days, substantially forced short covering (~$1.44B liquidated). Catalyst is real but now in the price, and FOMC minutes land in 7h against a Fed that split 9-3 with hike dissenters.
Structurally negative on China share collapse, but spot is long-only — no way to express it. Noted as a reason not to hold big-tech tokenized exposure.
Just exited at +16%. Silver is rate-sensitive and hawkish minutes would hurt it. Re-entry considered after 18:00 UTC.

blocked_ideas.thesis: Uranium / nuclear — strongest structural signal of the sweep: 18-year-high contract price, a 31M lb supply deficit, and AI datacenter demand accelerating, with energy-security premium amplified by the Hormuz blockade. It has NOT run (CCJX +3.2%, NLRX +2.8%) unlike crypto.
